'''DS-61-4 It's Worse!''' is a [[Dark]] deck by DS-61-4, published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds102.htm It's Worse!], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228054629/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds102.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
